notes.text: 1) Cod. تماس — 2) Cod. ح ط ن. Cf. adnotationes ad versionem. — 3) Cod. ض س ف — 4) Cod.

observations: L01, L07, L09, L10, L11, L14, L17, L21, L22: long joins (فـيما, عـلى, علامـتي, علامـة, موضـع, القمريّـة, وخـطّ, قطـر, بـه twice, زاويـة, وهـو) are not transcribed; nor the long kāf of مركـزها (L01), مركـز (L06) and فيكـون (L15).

The page continues chapter 30; it has no heading. The figure (F01) fills the left of the page beside L01-L19, which begin at 258-262 pt; L20-L22 run across the page under it. Nallino's line numbers 5, 10, 15 and 20 stand in the right margin beside L05, L10, L15 and L20; the codex's folio number f. 60,v. stands in the left margin, at the left of the figure, beside L18, the line of its asterisk (before ومثلَّث). The five notes stand in two lines under the rule. The printer's signature 12 stands at the foot (x 508.0-515.9 pt, the feet of its digits at 771.1 pt): the page is the first of the twelfth sheet.

The automatic geometry took the text beside the figure for the block and the figure for margin items; the lines, the block, the rule, the note lines, the margin items and the signature are measured from the ink of the page (the baseline of L22 from its bars, which stand 11.7 pt over it as on the other lines).

The figure (F01) is redrawn: the circle of the sun about د with its diameter from ج (left) to ا (right) and ب inside it over its foot; the circle of the moon about ط with ه at its left, ح at its right and ز under it; the circle of the earth about ن with ك at its left, م at its right and ل under it; the upright axis through the three centres from the top of the sun's circle to the apex of the cone, with س under the apex; the two sides of the cone from ج and ا, which touch the earth's circle at ك and م; the two lines from ج and ا that touch the moon's circle at ه and ح and cross at ن, the one from ج running on to ض (the line that note 4 of p. 88 says is wanting in the figure of the codex and of Plato's version); the line from ه through ط and ح to ق on the right side of the cone; the diameter ك م; the line ع ف ض between the sides of the cone. The three circles and the nine lines are least-squares fits to their printed ink, with their measured stroke widths (1.1-1.4 pt); the seventeen letters are typed at the centres of their printed ink.

The letters of the construction are overlined, each group under its own bar (the order of the letters under each bar from the places of their ink): L01 {ov:ه ز ح} (19.9 pt) and {ov:ط}; L03 {ov:ا} and {ov:ج} under two bars, {ov:ك} and {ov:م} under two bars; L04 {ov:س} and {ov:ا س ج} (22.9 pt); L05 {ov:د س}; L06 {ov:ن}; L07 {ov:ح} and {ov:ه}, {ov:ا} and {ov:ج}, each under its own bar; L09 {ov:ن}, {ov:ا ج} (13.0 pt) and {ov:ه ح} (13.0 pt); L10 {ov:ق} and {ov:ك م}; L12 {ov:ف}, {ov:ط ن}, {ov:ف ن} and {ov:د س}; L13 {ov:د ا}; L14 {ov:ط ح} and {ov:م ن}; L15 {ov:ع ف ض} (28.6 pt); L16 {ov:ف ض}; L17 {ov:ا س}; L18 {ov:ا د س}; L19 {ov:د س} and {ov:ح ن ط}; L20 {ov:ا د س}; L21 {ov:ض ن ف} (33.1 pt), {ov:ط ح} and {ov:ح ن ط}; L22 {ov:ط ح}, {ov:ض ن ف} and {ov:ف ض}. The ه of these groups is the small round form.

Abjad numerals, each under one bar: L18 {ov:قك} 120 (13.3 pt); L20 {ov:{0} يه م} 0;15,40 (22.6 pt) and {ov:شس} 360 (12.8 pt); L21 {ov:{0} م م} 0;40,40 (19.3 pt); L22 {ov:{0} يو كد} 0;16,24 (33.2 pt), followed by the reference to note 4, and {ov:{0} مب له} 0;42,35 (30.7 pt). The first sign of four of them is the codex's zero sign, the flat-topped sort of p. 81.
Final yā': with its two dots in في, التي, الذي, وهي (L06), خطَّيِ and طَرَفَيْ (L02), علامتَيْ (L03, L07), علامتي (L07) and نقطتيْ (L03); without dots in على, الى and مَجْرَى (L17).

L01: دارة: so printed, in both copies: dāl, alif, rā' and tā' marbūṭa, without the tooth and its hamza; دائرة stands at the end of the line and on L03, L07 and L08, and الدائرة on L20, each with the hamza over its tooth. وجعلْتُها: a round sukun on the top of the stem of the lām and a damma over the tā'.

L02: واخرجْتُ: no hamza; a round sukun high over the jīm and a damma over the tā'. خطَّيِ: over the ṭā' a shadda with a fatha above it and a kasra under the yā', beside its two dots. الشُّعاع: over the shīn a shadda with a damma in one cluster (4.0 x 6.1 pt). طَرَفَيْ: a fatha over the ṭā', a fatha over the rā', a fatha over the fā', above its dot, and a round sukun over the yā'. قُطْر (L02, L09): a damma over the qāf and a round sukun over the ṭā'.

L03: علامتَيْ (L03, L07): a fatha over the tā' and a round sukun over the yā'; علامتي (L07, the second): no signs. يُماسّان (L03) and يُماسّانِ (L06): a damma over the yā' and a shadda over the sīn, on L06 also a kasra under the last nūn; فيماسّان (L08): the shadda only. The reference to note 1 after يُماسّان. نقطتيْ: a round sukun over the yā', no fatha. ويلتقِيَانِ: a kasra under the qāf, a fatha over the second yā' and a kasra under the last nūn.
L04: الآخر: the madda over the alif. مثلَّث (L04, L20) and ومثلَّث (L18): over the lām a shadda with a fatha above it. خطّ and وخطّ (L04, L12-L17, L22) and فخطّ (L18): a shadda over the ṭā'.

L05: يقسِمه: a kasra under the sīn. بنصفَيْن: a fatha over the fā', above its dot, and a round sukun over the yā'. مثلَّثَيْن: over the lām a shadda with a fatha above it, a fatha over the second thā', which touches the top of the lām, and a round sukun over the yā' (2400 dpi). وكلّ: a shadda over the lām. قائم (L05, L18), القائمة and القائم (L20): the hamza over its tooth.

L06: وأَخرجْتُ: over the alif the hamza with a fatha above it in one sort (3.6 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the jīm and a damma over the tā'. ايضًا (L06, L10, L15, L19) and جزءًا (L17, L18, L19): fathatan; in جزءًا the hamza and its fathatan are one sort. خطَّيْن: over the ṭā' a shadda with a fatha above it and a round sukun over the yā'.
L07: ويجوزانِ: a kasra under the last nūn.

L08: أَجْل: over the alif the hamza with a fatha above it in one sort (3.6 x 5.0 pt) and beside it a round sukun over the jīm; أجْل (L12): the bare hamza (2.9 x 3.2 pt) and beside it the sukun, printed as a ring. الكُسوفات: a damma over the kāf. الشمسيّة (L08) and القمريّة (L11): a shadda over the yā'. يستُر: a damma over the tā'.

L09: كلَّها: over the lām a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks); كلّها (L13): the shadda only. ونُخْرِج (L09, L10, L15): a damma over the nūn, a round sukun high over the khā', above its dot, and a kasra under the rā'.
L10: ونُنْفِذه: a damma over the first nūn, a round sukun over the second and a kasra under the fā'. ونفرِض: a kasra under the rā'.
L11: بُعْده: a damma over the bā' and a round sukun over the ʿayn.
L12: ونجعَل: a fatha over the ʿayn. انّ (L12, L13): a shadda over the nūn, no hamza; أنّ (L17): the bare hamza over the alif and a shadda over the nūn.

L13: تَبَيَّنَ: a fatha over the tā', a fatha over the bā', over the yā' a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks) and a fatha over the nūn. الشَّكْل: over the shīn a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks) and a round sukun over the kāf.
L15: الظلّ (L15, L16): a shadda over the lām; on L16 the full stop after it.
L16: عمِل: a kasra under the mīm.
L17: مَجْرَى: a fatha over the mīm, a round sukun over the jīm and a fatha over the rā'. ستّين (L17, L19): a shadda over the tā'.
L18: والبعْد: a round sukun over the ʿayn, no damma. فخطّ: the dot of the fā' stands over the dot of the khā'.
L19: the reference to note 2 after {ov:ح ن ط}; on L21 the reference to note 3 and on L22 the reference to note 5 after {ov:ض ن ف}.

L21: فامّا (L21) and وامّا (L22): a shadda over the mīm. وَتَر (L21, L22): a fatha over the wāw and a fatha over the tā'. المنصَّف: over the ṣād a shadda with a fatha above it. يوتّر: a shadda over the tā'. فانّه: a shadda over the nūn, no hamza; فإِنّه (L22): the hamza and its kasra in one sort under the alif and a shadda over the nūn.

figures.note: the figure of chapter 30 for the distance of the sun (the circle of the sun about د with its diameter ج ا, the circle of the moon about ط and the circle of the earth about ن, their centres on the upright axis, which runs from the top of the sun's circle to the apex of the cone over س; the two sides of the cone from ج and ا, which touch the earth's circle at ك and م and meet at the apex; the two lines from ج and ا that touch the moon's circle at ه and ح and cross at ن, the one from ج running on to ض; the line from ه through ط and ح to ق on the right side of the cone; the diameter ك م of the earth; the line ع ف ض between the sides of the cone), measured with tools_s10/fig_measure.py at 600 dpi: the three circles and the nine lines are least-squares fits to their ink (stroke centres and widths), each line drawn between its meetings with the fitted circles and lines (the axis to the end of its ink; the line from ج to ض ends where it runs into the right side of the cone, 3.8 pt above the line ع ض, as in the print); the seventeen letters are set at the centres of their printed ink
